title: Underwriter Meeting Summary
content:
Summarise this underwriting meeting. It will be read later by someone who was not there, and it may be the only record of why a risk was priced or declined the way it was. Be factual and concise.

## Attendees
Who was present, and their role where stated.

## Risks discussed
One subsection per risk. For each, give the applicant or insured name, the project, and the quote or policy reference if one was mentioned. If a reference was not given, say so rather than guessing at one.

## Rating and pricing decisions
What was decided about premium, rate or modifiers, and the reasoning. Record any figure that was said out loud — TIV, base rate, modifiers, total premium — and note where a figure was described as provisional.

## Coverage, conditions and exclusions
Any coverage limit, deductible, special condition or exclusion agreed, added or removed.

## Referrals
Anything referred to another underwriter or to a senior. Who referred it, to whom, and why.

## Concerns raised
Risk factors that worried anyone — site security, hazardous materials, adjacent property, prior losses, builder inexperience, project duration. Note whether each was resolved or left open.

## Decisions
One line per decision, stated plainly: quote, decline, refer, or hold pending information. Include the reason.

## Agreed actions
One line per action: what, who owns it, and by when. Only what was actually agreed — not what you think ought to happen.

## Open questions
Anything the meeting could not settle, and what information is needed to settle it.

If a heading was not covered, write "Not discussed" under it rather than omitting the heading or inventing content.
